item.title: Joy as hardest hit KZN gets 200k doses of FMD vaccine
item.description: KwaZulu-Natal’s MEC for Agriculture and Rural Development, Thembeni kaMadlopha-Mthethwa, has expressed joy upon the arrival of one million foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccines from Biogénesis Bagó in Argentina. The much-needed vaccines arrived at the OR Tambo International Airport on Saturday and were officially received by the Department of Agriculture Minister John Steenhuisen.

item.title: Sihlobo expresses gratitude following presidential envoy appointment
item.description: Wandile Sihlobo, Chief Economist of the Agricultural Business Chamber of South Africa (Agbiz), has expressed his appreciation for the support he has received following his appointment as Presidential Envoy on Agriculture and Land.

item.title: FMD | Clover warns of ‘irreversible damage’ from control measures
item.description: Clover SA warns that foot-and-mouth disease control measures for dairy products in South Africa could cause irreversible economic damage to the local industry.

item.title: Canegrowers call for Ramaphosa’s help with threats to industry
item.description: The South African Canegrowers Association (SA Canegrowers)is directly calling on President Cyril Ramaphosa to help save the country’s approximately 25 000 sugarcane growers and six sugar milling companies from a very real risk of collapse of their industry.

item.title: WATCH | Aymos talks to us about music, farming and life beyond the stage
item.description: In this exclusive interview, award-winning Amapiano star Babili “Aymos” Shili takes us behind the scenes of his life off the stage. From the rhythm of the studio to the rows of peppers on his farm in Bapsfontein, Aymos shares how music and farming have shaped his values, discipline, and vision for the next generation.
